headline: Full rest after Tuesday's tempo-labelled run and fragmented sleep
summary: Garmin recorded 8h 19m of sleep, but the score was only 67 because the sleep was discontinuous. Training Readiness is 35 (Low), recovery time is 11h 30m, and Tuesday's run added load 143 with aerobic effect 3.5. Take full rest from training today.

recovery.label: Sleep
recovery.context: Confirmed Sydney sleep window: approximately 6 October 20:31–7 October 06:11. Garmin scored 8h 19m as sleep within the 9h 40m window and described it as long but discontinuous; the estimated need was 9h.

recovery.label: Sleeping HR
recovery.context: 1.0 bpm above the prior 7-night valid-sample average of 67.0 and 0.5 bpm above the prior 14-night valid-sample average of 67.5 (13 valid nights).

recovery.label: Resting HR
recovery.context: 1 bpm below Garmin's seven-day average of 60 bpm.

recovery.label: HRV
recovery.context: The overnight value is 1 ms below the weekly average, and Garmin classifies HRV as balanced.

recovery.label: Stress
recovery.context: Today's average stress is an incomplete early-morning device measurement; Garmin's average sleep stress was 23.

recovery.label: Body Battery
recovery.context: Garmin recorded 44 points charged overnight and a 47-point sleep impact.

recovery.label: Training Readiness
recovery.context: Garmin reported 11h 30m of recovery time and advises focusing on sleep quality.

recovery.label: Recent load
recovery.context: Garmin classifies the ratio as optimal, but Tuesday's run added load 143 and the acute load has risen materially.

yesterday.prescribed: No daily report was published for 6 October because the required overnight-data gate did not pass, so there was no valid daily prescription to assess.

environment.observed_temperature_range: Garmin device measurement: 24–29°C during the run.
environment.humidity_dew_point_context: A reliable route-time Sydney hourly humidity/dew-point estimate was not available, so none is reported.

recommendation.title: Full rest from running and cycling
details: Do not run, cycle, perform strength work, or add make-up mileage today.
Optional only: 20–30 minutes of very easy walking or 10–15 minutes of gentle mobility, provided you feel alert and movement is comfortable.
Reassess after the next completed overnight record before deciding on Thursday's usual group easy run.
recommendation.alternative: Complete rest with normal essential daily movement.
recommendation.reduce_or_stop: Stop optional movement for pain that changes gait, dizziness, unusual sleepiness, dehydration symptoms, illness, chest symptoms or any other concerning symptom. Current symptoms and medical advice override Garmin scores.

signals.label: Low readiness
signals.interpretation: Garmin's combined recovery assessment does not support another training session today.

signals.label: Tuesday training dose
signals.interpretation: The short run still delivered a substantial mixed training stimulus and should be absorbed before the next session.

signals.label: Sleep quality
signals.interpretation: Duration was adequate, but fragmentation and only fair sleep quality limit confidence in recovery.

caveats: Sleeping-HR baselines use valid prior nights only because Garmin supplied no valid overnight record for 27 September.
